places-cavidad-vi-cueva-del-peliciego.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cavidad-vi-cueva-del-peliciego.story: From Nerpio it runs 350 km to Nerpio; allow about 6 h 02 of riding. It goes by way of Solana del molinico, Cueva del Niño, Cavidad II and Cueva del Peliciego. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-nockalm-road.slogan: Nockalm Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-nockalm-road.story: A high alpine toll road from Innerkrems, Austria to Ebene Reichenau, Austria, via Eisentalhohe. Key character: rounded peaks; larch forest; sweeping bends. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Nockalm Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 6 km this is Nockalm Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
